title: Chapter 397 The Bloodthirsty Spear Broke
content:
Chapter 397 The Bloodthirsty Spear Broke

No monsters were encountered along the way, which shows that all the monsters' strength has been put into the battle.

After walking 5 kilometers, Wang Shuo found the gathering place of the monsters.

This place is full of monster feces and stinks.

In the distance, there is a barrier light curtain blocking Wang Shuo's way forward.

At this time, Wang Shuo felt that the third sachet given to him by Lord Zach had a reaction.

Wang Shuo opened it.

[Three months later, Dahuai Territory will be completely connected to the outside world. ]

Wang Shuo's heart trembled. Just a vanguard force from the outside world almost conquered Dahuai Territory.

If more armies attacked, could Dahuai Territory still resist?

Wang Shuo was uneasy.

But this was not the time to think about this problem.

Wang Shuo immediately commanded his troops to sweep across other sections of the city wall.

The monsters and wild beasts left under the city wall were no match for the Knights of Hell.

At this time in this battle, Wang Shuo felt a little refreshed.

Soon he killed to the position where Zhao Bangde was.

Seeing Wang Shuo coming, Zhao Bangde's eyes lit up. It seemed that this battle would come to a temporary end.

At this time, Zhao Bangde was fighting fiercely with Apache. The two of them had been fighting for several hours, and the two sides still had not decided the winner.

But more and more people came to support, and the balance of victory had tilted towards Zhao Bangde.

The monsters saw that the situation was over, but they were still fighting hard.

Because they could not go back, they had no choice but to die in battle or surrender.

Apache looked around, his heart was desolate, he couldn't figure out why he was defeated!

At the same time, the Black Dragon King had also captured the headquarters of the invading coalition.

The bloodthirsty army was annihilated, and even the commander-in-chief Jin Guozhu had been killed by the Black Dragon King.

At this time, the Black Dragon King was considering whether to take the opportunity to attack the human soldiers led by Zhao Bangde.

This was a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

He kept calculating in his mind, how sure was he in this battle?

You know, although he wiped out a large number of humans and obtained corpses, it still takes some time for these corpses to transform into undead.

Especially some high-level corpses, the transformation time is longer.

In the previous battle, one of his four legion commanders also died.

At this time, they actually only have four general-level combat forces.

Of course, they still have some undead beasts, whose combat power is comparable to that of generals, but they are still a little worse.

The Black Dragon King is waiting, waiting for Zhao Bangde to be injured.

As long as Zhao Bangde and Apache fight to a loss, then he will have absolute confidence in this battle.

But as the number of monsters decreases, the Black Dragon King feels more and more that he cannot act rashly.

At this time, Wang Shuo has also cleaned up the monsters under the city wall.

Then, he climbed up the city wall with a rope.

As soon as he jumped down, he found his old enemy, the crocodile man.

Wang Shuo immediately ignited a raging fighting spirit.

At the beginning, Wang Shuo was suppressed by the crocodile man. If he hadn't used thunder bombs to injure him, he would have had no time to rescue him. The wall that was breached by the monster warrior team might have been defeated in this battle.

At this time, the crocodile man was also in a very bad condition. After a series of battles, he was also a little exhausted.

Moreover, his injuries had not been recovered. He didn't have good things like the water of life.

Wang Shuo jumped forward directly, raised the blood-crying gun in his hand high, and smashed it towards the crocodile man's head.

But something unexpected happened to Wang Shuo.

The blood-crying gun had been severely damaged after a long fight. The crocodile man didn't know what secret method he used. A sharp spike stretched out of his head and broke Wang Shuo's blood-crying gun.
